comments.text: Also, the easiest way to remember the Seven Sisters of India is double A, triple M, N, T, which can be written as A-A, M-M-M, N, T. Here, A stands for Arunachal Pradesh and Assam, M stands for Manipur, Meghalaya, and Mizoram, N stands for Nagaland, and T stands for Tripura.
comments.author: @MuthuSivagnanam
